sources.name: lyons.librarycalendar.com
sources.notes: Its iCal feed (feedUrl) is offered to readers to subscribe to in a calendar app. The site's robots.txt disallows every path for agents it does not name, so the event pages are not read; the feed is, under robots: subscribe, by the nightly re-check only, once a night, to confirm listings already on the guide (decided 17 October 2026 under the owner's delegation; the permission request of docs/archive/emails/SOURCE-PERMISSION-EMAILS.md stands as a courtesy). Type stays manual: ingest does not read it until the library answers. Found 4 October 2026; about 120 events, UTC times.

sources.name: Creative Grounds
sources.notes: Confirmed 28 October 2026 at the owner's direction: Creative Grounds (160 E Main St) is a source for Lyons events, and every class on its calendar is listed. A Squarespace events list at /classes, one page per class date with its time, price and sign-up. Its robots.txt disallows ?format=ical and ?format=json for every agent, so there is no feed to read; type stays html and the pages are read by hand. Casey at Creative Grounds is the contact (docs/relationships/contacts/creative-grounds.md).

sources.name: rockgardenlyons.com
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Read 10 November 2026: The Rock Garden is the beer garden at A-Lodge, 338 Main St. Its /events page is a Squarespace events collection (one page per show, named bands on Fridays and Saturdays, 6 to 9 pm, May to October). The page was fetched once; its newest item was Butter Machine on 31 October 2026 and nothing is dated 10 November to 10 December on the site itself, so 0 worth a row from this page. An aggregator (happeningnext.com/lyons-co, read the same day) shows one late show the venue posted on Facebook only: Arthur Lee Land's Twang Is Dead ReMixed solo show, 15 November. The robots.txt allows the pages but disallows ?format=json and ?format=ical for every agent, and ingest cannot read Squarespace yet, so type stays html. It is a summer source: about 6 to 8 named shows a month in season. Suggested exclusion: CLOSED FOR A PRIVATE EVENT.

sources.name: lyonsrecorder.org
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Read 10 November 2026: only the robots.txt was fetched. It opens with 'User-agent: * Disallow: /' (its own comment says the block was added 19 November 2024 to prohibit all), so no page and no feed was read today. The guide's listings cite its calendar at /events/ and pages of the form /event/<name>/<date>/, which is the shape of The Events Calendar, so an iCal export at /events/?ical=1 and the JSON at /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events probably exist; neither was fetched or verified. Reading it needs the Recorder's permission or the owner's decision; until then type stays html and it is read by a person.

sources.name: Lyons Middle Senior High School (community calendar)
sources.defaultVenue: Lyons Middle Senior High School, 100 McConnell Drive
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The school is at 100 McConnell Drive, Lyons (its own home page). The home page embeds a public Google Calendar named Lyons Middle Senior Community Calendar (id c_2a55ijpsj3lakhj6u9p82cr5ns@group.calendar.google.com, time zone America/Denver); its iCal feed was fetched once and holds 1156 events going back years. Dated 10 November to 10 December 2026: 11 items, 3 worth a row: HS Boys and Girls Basketball home against Brush on 1 December at 4 pm, home against Wiggins on 8 December at 5 pm, and the MS/HS Band Concerts in the auditorium on 10 December at 7 pm. The rest are never-list or another town's: away games, middle school games and a dance, Thanksgiving break, the band at Longmont's Veterans Day parade, an open house. After the window it carries seven more home basketball dates to 20 February and the MS/HS Choir Concert on 10 March 2027. Times are in UTC in the feed (an evening event shows the next day's date in UTC). The feed also repeats the Town's Parade of Lights (5 December, 6:30 pm), which the guide already lists from the Town. calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows /calendar, so reading it needs the editor's robots: subscribe, as the other guides' school calendars did on 10 November. The guide's school sports config (src/config/school-sports.ts) may already cover the games; if so only the concerts and plays are new. Suggested exclusions are in excludeTitles; add any test days and conferences seen on the first read.

sources.name: MainStage Brewing Company (music and events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 450 Main St, Lyons (its own home page; a second taproom is in Gunbarrel). A Squarespace site; its robots.txt allows the pages and disallows ?format=json and ?format=ical. /music has no Squarespace calendar: it shows the brewery's Facebook events through a SociableKit widget, one for Lyons and one for Gunbarrel, found by loading the page in a browser. The Lyons widget's data file (https://data.accentapi.com/feed/25613350.json, a host with no robots.txt) was fetched once: 19 items, 9 November to 1 December. Worth a row, 3: Pottery with a Purpose workshop on 14 November, noon to 2 pm; Lucky's Vegan Night on 22 November; the Christmas Tree Sale, Trees with Purpose, 27 to 29 November, 1 to 7 pm. Regulars, 16 dates: Trivia Night on Tuesdays at 6:30, Open Bluegrass Pick on Thursdays at 6, $5 Dice and Drafts on Wednesdays, Teacher Appreciation Mondays, the Lyons Health and Wellness Running Club on alternate Tuesdays at 5:30, Pints and Pages Book Club on 11 November (the library's, already on the guide). No named bands are booked in the widget for this window; the first Friday art opening the guide lists is not in it either. Type manual: the widget file is a third party's format ingest cannot read, and it only looks about three weeks ahead. In the summer the patio books named acts and the MainGrass festival (/maingrass, not fetched).

sources.name: The Lyons Farmette (workshops and farm dinners)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 4121 Ute Highway, Lyons (the address on its own event pages). A Squarespace site with two event collections: /workshops-and-events and /dinners (ticketed farm dinners with named restaurants, summer only; the 2026 ones were Blackbelly on 15 July and 9 September, Butcher and the Blonde on 12 August, Corrida on 26 August). Both pages and /calendar (a wedding availability page, no events) were fetched once. Workshops listed: 4 items; dated 10 November to 10 December and worth a row, 2: Intro to Branch Weaving on Sunday 15 November, 1 to 5 pm, and the Winter Attunement Yin Workshop on Sunday 6 December, 2 to 3:30 pm. After that, Two-Day Workshop: Pack Baskets on 20 February 2027. An aggregator also shows a class called HELD at the Farmette on 10 December that is not on the Farmette's own page; not verified. No regulars and nothing to exclude. The robots.txt allows the pages and disallows ?format=json and ?format=ical for every agent, and ingest cannot read Squarespace yet, so type html, read by hand: about 2 workshops a month in winter, plus 4 or 5 farm dinners from July to September.

sources.name: Spirit Hound Distillers (Lyons tasting room events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. 4196 Ute Highway, Lyons (its own page; it also has a Denver lounge at 3622 Tejon St, whose events are not Lyons'). A Wix site; its robots.txt allows the pages. /lyons-tasting-room says the room has events every week and has a section headed Upcoming Lyons Tasting Room Events, but the list is not in the page: it is an AnyRoad booking widget (plugin name spirit_hound_lyons_eventsclasses, seen when the page was loaded in a browser). The robots.txt of both AnyRoad hosts (app.anyroad.com and integrations.anyroad.com) disallows every path, so the list was not read and nothing was counted. /food-trucks and /cocktail-classes were fetched but not read through; food trucks are regulars and the cocktail classes page is under the Denver lounge. No iCal or RSS. Type manual: a person opens the page. Not fetched: the event list itself.

sources.name: Oskar Blues Grill & Brew (music calendar)
sources.defaultVenue: Oskar Blues Grill & Brew, 303 Main St
sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026; could not be read. 303 Main St, Lyons (the guide's own place file). www.oskarbluesfooderies.com answers every request, robots.txt included, with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403), so neither the rules nor the calendar could be fetched; that is a blocker and it was not worked around. The brewery's other site, oskarblues.com, and Bandsintown both name ClaudeBot with Disallow: /, so they were not read either. That the room books named acts most weekends is seen only second hand, on an aggregator (happeningnext.com/lyons-co, which has no robots.txt, fetched once; it repeats Facebook events): The Sunday Serenade with Ingrid Avison on 15 November, Country Rhythm Outfit featuring Greg Schochet on 21 November, The Sunday Serenade with Mollie O'Brien and Rich Moore on 22 November, Sugar Britches Full Band on 27 November, Crick Wooder on 28 November. That is 5 dates worth a row in the first three weeks of the window, from a page that shows only about 20 Lyons items in all; none was checked against the venue. The guide has the Old Time Jam and the Sunday Serenade as standing listings from the Lyons Recorder; the named act each Sunday and the Friday and Saturday bands are what is missing. Type manual: someone reads the venue's own page or its Facebook events by hand, weekly.

sources.name: Lyons Redstone Museum (history talks and calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The Lyons Historical Society's museum (the guide's place file has it at 340 High St). A Weebly site; its robots.txt allows the pages. /events.html and /whats-new.html were fetched once: a hand-written list for the year, no feed. The museum closed for the winter on 30 September, so 0 are dated 10 November to 10 December. The 2026 list had 2 events worth a row: History Day on 27 June, 1 to 4:30 pm, with five new exhibits, and Unearth a Story: A Local History Night at the Lyons Regional Library on 28 July; plus an all-day fundraiser at Oskar Blues on 21 July and the season's opening days (weekends from 2 May, daily from 1 June). Type html, a monthly look from April to September is enough.

sources.name: Lyons Community Foundation (community events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Lyons Community Foundation, PO Box 546, Lyons; its events are in Bohn Park and Sandstone Park. A Wix site; its robots.txt allows the pages. /events was fetched once: a hand-written page of the year's three events, no feed (the site's only feed is a blog RSS, /blog-feed.xml, not fetched). 0 dated 10 November to 10 December. What it carries each year: Earth Day in Bohn Park (25 April 2026, river cleanup at 8 am, talks at 11, 12 and 1), the Sandstone Summer Concerts (Wednesdays 17 June to 12 August 2026, 6:30 to 8:30 pm, the Town's series), and the Hootenanny in Bohn Park (29 August 2026, 3 to 7 pm). Type html, a monthly look is enough; the Town's calendar feed already carries most of these dates.
